newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ACF PROVISIONAL 1996 NET NLG 16 MLN.
newsitem.headline: ACF PROVISIONAL 1996 NET NLG 16 MLN.

text.p: Pharmaceuticals company ACF Holding NV said provisional figures showed it made a net profit of over 16 million guilders in 1996, down from 22.3 million in 1995.
ACF said government-imposed reductions in medicine prices had a substantial effect on its sales and profits in 1996.
However, profits for the whole year were higher than had been expected when first-half results were published in August.
ACF said its market share recovered during the course of 1996 after coming under pressure at the start of the year.
It said it would publish final 1996 results and its dividend proposal on April 6.
The company said that to increase efficiency it planned to regroup its businesses into three clusters: pharmaceutical wholesaling, production and other activities.
